fullPassage: When gathering the preferences of multiple agents into one collective choice, it is easily seen that certain cases call for randomization or other means of tiebreaking. For example, if there are two alternatives, a and b, and two agents such that one prefers a and the other one b, there is no deterministic way of selecting a single alternative without violating one of two basic fairness conditions known as anonymity and neutrality. Anonymity requires that the collective choice ought to be independent of the agents' identities whereas neutrality requires impartiality towards the alternatives. Allowing lotteries as social outcomes hence seems like a necessity for impartial collective choice. Indeed, most common "deterministic" social choice functions such as plurality rule are only deterministic as long as there is no tie, which is usually resolved by drawing a lot. The use of lotteries for the selection of officials interestingly goes back to the world's first democracy in Athens, where it was widely regarded as a principal characteristic of democracy, and has recently gained increasing attention in political science.

✅ ③ favoritism: 편파/편애 → impartiality(공정성)의 반의어 ←정답
❌ ④ fairness: 공정성 → impartiality의 유의어
det.tip: impartiality(공정성/편견 없음) ↔ favoritism(편파/편애). 중립성은 대안에 대한 공정성을 요구한다

questions.stem: 다음 두 문장에서 밑줄 친 draw의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) draw a lot = 제비를 뽑다/추첨하다 / (B) draw a portrait = 초상화를 그리다
det.analysis:
❌ ① 그리다 — 추첨하다: (A)는 제비뽑기(추첨)이지 그리는 행위가 아님
❌ ② 끌다 — 그리다: (A)는 끌다가 아니라 추첨하다
❌ ③ 추첨하다 — 추첨하다: (B)는 초상화를 그리는 것이지 추첨이 아님
✅ ④ 추첨하다 — 그리다: (A) draw a lot=추첨하다, (B) draw a portrait=그리다 ←정답
det.tip: draw: (1) 추첨하다 (draw a lot = 제비뽑기) (2) 그리다 (draw a picture = 그림을 그리다)

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "the condition of being unknown or unidentified, especially in order to avoid unfair treatment"

det.korean: 알려지지 않거나 식별되지 않는 상태 = anonymity(익명성)
det.analysis:
✅ ① anonymity: 익명성 → 신원이 알려지지 않은/식별되지 않은 상태와 정확히 일치 ←정답
❌ ② neutrality: 중립성 → 신원이 아닌 태도의 공정성에 관한 것
❌ ③ plurality: 다수 → 수의 개념이지 신원 은닉이 아님
❌ ④ impartiality: 공정성 → 편견 없음이지 신원 비공개가 아님
det.tip: anonymity = 익명성. the condition of being unknown = 알려지지 않은 상태

questions.passage: For example, if there are two alternatives, a and b, and two agents such that one prefers a and the other one b, there is no deterministic way of __________ (select) a single alternative without violating one of two basic fairness conditions known as anonymity and neutrality.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어, 영어로)

det.korean: a way of selecting = 선택하는 방법. select → 동명사 selecting
det.analysis: 동사 select → 동명사 selecting. 'a way of _____ a single alternative'에서 전치사 of 뒤에 동명사가 필요
det.tip: select → selecting(선택하는 것). a way of + V-ing 구문

questions.passage: There is no deterministic way of selecting a single alternative without violating one of two basic fairness conditions __________ (know) as anonymity and neutrality.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어, 영어로)

det.korean: conditions known as = ~으로 알려진 조건. know → 과거분사 known
det.analysis: 동사 know → 과거분사 known. 'conditions _____ as anonymity and neutrality'에서 명사 뒤 과거분사가 후치수식. 조건이 '알려진' 것이므로 수동의 의미
det.tip: know → known(알려진). conditions known as = ~으로 알려진 조건들. 과거분사의 후치수식

questions.passage: When gathering the preferences of multiple agents into one collective choice, it is easily seen that certain cases call for randomization or other means of tiebreaking. For example, if there are two alternatives, a and b, and two agents such that one prefers a and the other one b, there is no deterministic way of selecting a single alternative without violating one of two basic fairness conditions known as anonymity and neutrality. Anonymity requires that the collective choice ought to be __________ whereas neutrality requires impartiality towards the alternatives. Allowing lotteries as social outcomes hence seems like a necessity for impartial collective choice. Indeed, most common "deterministic" social choice functions such as plurality rule are only deterministic as long as there is no tie, which is usually resolved by drawing a lot. The use of lotteries for the selection of officials interestingly goes back to the world's first democracy in Athens, where it was widely regarded as a principal characteristic of democracy, and has recently gained increasing attention in political science.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 집단적 선택이 주체의 정체성과 독립적이어야 한다
det.analysis:
✅ ① independent of the agents' identities: 주체의 정체성과 독립적 → 익명성의 정의와 일치 ←정답
❌ ② based on each voter's social status: 사회적 지위에 기반 → 익명성과 정반대
❌ ③ determined by the majority rule alone: 다수결로만 결정 → 익명성이 아닌 다수결 규칙
❌ ④ limited to political representatives only: 정치적 대표자에게만 한정 → 익명성과 무관
det.tip: Anonymity requires that the collective choice ought to be independent of the agents' identities

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 추첨이 민주주의의 주요 특성으로 널리 간주되었다
det.analysis:
❌ ① an outdated method of governance: 구시대적 통치 방법 → 본문은 최근 정치학에서 관심 증가를 언급
✅ ② a principal characteristic of democracy: 민주주의의 주요 특성 → 아테네에서 추첨이 민주주의의 핵심 특성으로 간주되었다는 원문과 일치 ←정답
❌ ③ a barrier to efficient decision-making: 효율적 의사결정의 장벽 → 본문은 추첨을 긍정적으로 서술
❌ ④ a tool for authoritarian control: 권위주의적 통제 수단 → 민주주의와 반대되는 개념
det.tip: widely regarded as a principal characteristic of democracy. 추첨은 세계 최초의 민주주의(아테네)에서 핵심 특성으로 간주
